howto: Drop a group of files (or a folder) onto the dropzone.
The tool hashes every file with SHA-256 using your browser's Web Crypto API.
Files sharing an identical hash are grouped as duplicates.
Read the duplicate groups and the total space you could free by removing the extras.
Delete the duplicates in your own file manager — this tool never deletes anything.
features: Hundreds of files handled at once, with progress feedback
Duplicate groups clearly listed with file sizes
Estimate of disk space that could be freed

faq.q: How accurate is SHA-256 duplicate detection?
faq.a: Very accurate. Two different files with the same SHA-256 hash are effectively impossible, so matching hashes mean the files are byte-for-byte identical.
No. It only identifies duplicates. You delete them yourself in your file manager, which is safer.

faq.q: What about large files — will it freeze?
faq.a: Hashing runs asynchronously with a progress indicator, so large files are processed in chunks without freezing the page.

faq.q: Can it find duplicates that differ only by filename?
faq.a: Yes — that is exactly what it is for. Two copies of the same photo with different names share the same hash and are reported as duplicates.
